title: First run and library folder
summary: One welcome screen with a text-only Create Library button → the system folder picker → the empty library (example cover “Fog”, Create book).

title: Home: your library
summary: The library: a top bar with the folder path and Change, then your books as realistic book objects with a meta line, or the empty library.

title: Import a photo folder
summary: Photos come in by folder only: Add folder… or drop a folder. The filmstrip fills progressively; moved folders are relinked.

title: Editor: spreads and layout
summary: The book editor: spreads on a pasteboard, templates, drag and drop from the filmstrip, zoom, history and side panels.

title: Editor chrome, saving and access
summary: The design system the editor is built on, plus the always-on states: autosave, folder access, single editor, the Procreate-light theme.

title: Free layout: grids, guides, frames
summary: Layouts beyond templates: rulers, guides, layout grids with snapping, free frames, handles, inspector, stacking and multi-select.

title: Text, styles and parent spreads
summary: Captions and text blocks, frame styles, your own templates and parent spreads with inherited grids, guides and page numbers.

title: Presentation
summary: Full-screen preview of the book, spread by spread.

title: Print preparation
summary: Print-aware editing: the DPI badge, bleed / trim / safe overlays, preflight warnings and fixes, and the cover editor.

title: Print export
summary: What leaves the app for the printer: PDF, JPEG spreads, the print package report, home booklets and the cover PDF.

title: Showcase site
summary: The public site with your books: the viewer, the lightbox and the in-editor preview.

title: Export and publish the site
summary: Write the site to a folder, choose web image sizes, deploy by hand or with the Publish button.

title: Settings
summary: App settings: the library folder (Change library folder…), hosting, site personalisation and printer presets.

title: Unsupported browser
summary: Shown instead of the app when the browser has no File System Access API (Firefox, Safari, mobile): use Chrome or another Chromium desktop browser.
